name: Beijing
summary: Beijing is the political and historical heart of China: the Forbidden City, the Great Wall at the city gates and an ultra-modern subway that connects a metropolis of more than 20 million people. The cost of living is remarkably low for the size of the city, but the Great Firewall blocks Google, WhatsApp, Instagram and Gmail, so you need a reliable VPN installed before you arrive. China does not offer a digital nomad visa, so working remotely is usually done under a tourist visa, in an ambiguous legal zone.
